title: task.created payload
description: Emitted by Notifications & Messaging when a task is created (assigned to a user or group). Consumed by the WebSocket service and Logging. A workflow human-task (workflow.task.created from BMS) is materialized as one of these.

subjectRef.description: What the task is about (asset, workflow instance, story...).

workflowInstanceId.description: Set when the task originates from a BMS human step.
